entities.summary: Roman city near Naples buried by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 CE, preserving an extraordinary snapshot of daily life in the Roman Empire. Excavations beginning in 1748 revealed streets, homes, shops, temples, brothels, and even food — making Pompeii the most important archaeological site for understanding Roman urban life.
